items.headline: Bears call on QB3 Case Keenum in rousing victory over Eagles
items.description: In his first NFL start in 1,009 days, Chicago third-string quarterback Case Keenum, 38, led the Bears to a dominant 27-7 victory over the perennial NFC heavyweight Philadelphia Eagles on Monday, a performance coach Ben Johnson labeled "extraordinary."

items.headline: Sirianni regrets reaction to hit on QB Hurts in Eagles' loss
items.description: After a 27-7 loss to Chicago on Monday, Eagles coach Nick Sirianni expressed "remorse" over his reaction to a sideline hit by Bears linebacker D'Marco Jackson on Philadelphia's Jalen Hurts that temporarily knocked his quarterback out of the first half.

items.headline: Case Keenum drives Chicago to 3 touchdowns as the Bears beat the Eagles 27-7
items.description: — Case Keenum was on target and on time all night long.
